welcome_title: Discover the career that fits you
welcome_subtitle: Answer a short personality test and skills assessment to get AI-powered career recommendations.
about_team_info_text:
We are a small student team that developed CareerPilot AI with the goal of using artificial intelligence to help people better understand their skills and career paths.

Our focus is on combining programming, artificial intelligence, and user experience design to build practical and usable tools.

To contact the Digital Engineers team, you can reach us via the email below: digitalengineersofficial@gmail.com
